name: End-to-end orchestrator-path verification on a 12-job 5k-step micro-test before committing to full Tier 1
summary_one_line: Training plumbing OK; eval plumbing fails for intent=ON (50% of Tier 1); meta.json schema and Fusion-fix CSV propagation missing.

compute_used.policy: killed orchestrator at 18:25 elapsed (under 30-min budget) once intent-eval failure was decisive; nointent eval was ~95% complete on 6 jobs
compute_used.convergence_reason_in_meta: max_steps_reached (n_steps=4096 forces overshoot — first multiple of 4096 >= 5000)

manifest_subsetting_approach.spec_text: Modify run_full_ablation.py temporarily — OR use a CLI flag if --max_jobs or --dry_run already exists
manifest_subsetting_approach.approach_used: Used existing CLI filter flags --scenarios 1a --maneuvers stem_right --seeds 42 (no manifest modification)
manifest_subsetting_approach.rationale: run_full_ablation.py already implements --seeds, --methods, --scenarios, --maneuvers, --intents filters at lines 539-558 (Phase 2 / Step 2). No file edit needed; --include_rule_based defaults to False, dropping rule_based from training jobs.

C1_orchestrator_detached_via_nohup_setsi.detail: Orchestrator launched with `nohup setsid ...`; orchestrator's PPID after launch was 1 (init) per ps; child shells (12) reparented to orchestrator's session via setsid. Survives parent terminal close.

C2_parallel_sumo_processes_observed.detail: At ~15s elapsed: 12 distinct python3 train_*.py subprocesses running concurrently (CPU 89-95% per proc); 12 GPU processes in nvidia-smi (218-554 MiB each, total 4.6 GB / 20 GB); GPU utilization 98%; 13 SUMO-related processes total. Confirmed parallel via htop equivalent (ps -ef | grep -E '(train_|eval.py)' showed 12 train procs + their shell wrappers).

C3_metrics_csv_present_per_job.detail: All 12 jobs produced metrics.csv with header + 2 iter rows (5000 -> 8192 actual). Header == METRICS_COLUMNS exactly (25 cols).

C4_eval_metrics_csv_present_per_job.detail: Per nointent (6 jobs): 224-292 episode rows out of 300 expected (eval was ~95% complete when killed; full completion was projected ~25 min total wall-clock). Per intent (6 jobs): 1 row (header only) — eval.py CRASHED at startup before logging any episode (see C7 root cause).

C5_meta_json_has_criterion_version.detail: 0/12 meta.json files contain `criterion_version`. `experiments/pde/run_metadata.py:write_meta_start` does NOT write this field. The post-run annotation function `verification/phase3F_step11_orchestrator.py:append_criterion_version_to_metas` (lines 124-139) is what added it during Step 11, but `run_full_ablation.py` does NOT call any equivalent — Tier 1 launches via this orchestrator would never annotate.
remediation_options: A. Add `criterion_version: 'v2_sr_primary_post_stage3'` to the meta dict in run_metadata.py:write_meta_start (sourced from config_frozen_v1.yaml::calibration.criterion_version)
B. Wrap run_full_ablation.py with a post-run annotation step analogous to verification/phase3F_step11_orchestrator.py
C. Have analysis pipeline read criterion_version from config_frozen_v1.yaml at analysis time rather than from per-job meta.json

C6_meta_json_has_tier_label.detail: 0/12 meta.json files contain `tier_label` or `tier`. `experiments/pde/run_metadata.py:write_meta_start` does NOT accept or write a tier field. The job dict in run_full_ablation.py:generate_jobs has `tier: 1` (line 436) but it is never propagated to per-job meta.json — train_*.py scripts are unaware of which tier they belong to.
remediation_options: A. Pass tier as a CLI flag from run_full_ablation.py to each train_*.py invocation (would require add_common_cli_args change + write_meta_start signature change)
B. Annotate post-run (write tier into meta.json by orchestrator after subprocess completion)
C. Have analysis pipeline derive tier from output_dir path (e.g., `tier1` segment) rather than from meta.json

C7_intent_eval_input_dim_mismatch.detail: All 6 intent-ON jobs FAIL at eval-phase startup with `RuntimeError: input.size(-1) must be equal to input_size. Expected 165, got 135`. Trained intent policy expects obs_dim=165 (135 base + 30 intent block); eval feeds obs_dim=135 because eval was launched without `--use_intent`.
C7_intent_eval_input_dim_mismatch.root_cause: experiments/pde/run_full_ablation.py:_build_eval_cmd (lines 216-239) does NOT take a use_intent parameter and does NOT pass `--use_intent` to eval.py. The Tier 1 generator at line 432-434 calls _build_eval_cmd without any intent forwarding, even though the same loop iterates over intent values.

evidence.eval_does_NOT_pass_use_intent: experiments/pde/run_full_ablation.py:_build_eval_cmd has NO use_intent parameter and never appends --use_intent

C7_intent_eval_input_dim_mismatch.production_impact: 50% of Tier 1 jobs (every intent=true cell, 720 of 1,440 trainable jobs, or 840 of 1,680 with rule_based) would fail at eval phase. Tier 1 eval data would be missing for the entire intent-ON half of the grid. Tier 4 held-out eval (which calls _build_eval_cmd similarly) is also affected for any intent-trained source checkpoints.
C7_intent_eval_input_dim_mismatch.minimal_fix_proposal: 1) Add `use_intent: bool = False` parameter to _build_eval_cmd. 2) After existing flag handling, if use_intent: cmd.append('--use_intent'). 3) At line 434 call site: `cmd_eval=_build_eval_cmd(method, scen, man, seed, out_dir, use_intent=intent)`.

C8_fusion_metrics_csv_has_new_columns.detail: Both fusion_aux jobs' metrics.csv have header == METRICS_COLUMNS (25 fields) — the new diagnostic columns `distill_loss_optimality_component` and `distill_loss_safety_component` are NOT in metrics.csv. The fusion fix (verified-applied to models/pde/fusion_aux_agent.py) added these to the train_step() return dict, but train_fusion_aux.py never extracts them and the canonical METRICS_COLUMNS in run_metadata.py was not extended.
remediation_options: A. Add the two columns to METRICS_COLUMNS in run_metadata.py and update train_fusion_aux.py to write metrics.get('distill_loss_optimality_component', 0) / ('distill_loss_safety_component', 0). Note: this would change the canonical schema for ALL methods — non-fusion methods would write 0 (or nulls) for these columns. Acceptable per the existing schema pattern that already does this for several PDE-method-specific fields.

B. Use a fusion-specific auxiliary CSV (e.g., extend the legacy train_fusion_aux_<scen>_<man>.csv at lines 162-174 to include the new columns) and have analysis read from that file for fusion jobs only.

C. Drop the requirement — verify the fix architecturally via code inspection (already done in verification/fusion_fix_verification.json) and rely on overall L_residual_safety being non-zero as the runtime sanity check.

C9_no_nan_inf_in_metrics.detail: 0/12 jobs had any NaN or inf in any numeric column of metrics.csv (header + 2 data rows × 24 numeric columns × 12 jobs = 576 cells scanned).

C10_fusion_L_residual_safety_nonzero.detail: Both fusion_aux jobs have at least one iteration with L_residual_safety > 0, confirming the U_safety gradient path is live. But values are sporadic at 5k on sparse 1a (one iter zero, one iter ~0.04). Consistent with prior 50k smoke verification result of 0.427 on 2_dense (denser scenario, longer horizon).
C10_fusion_L_residual_safety_nonzero.interpretation: Gradient path structurally correct per code inspection + non-zero observation. The intermittent zeros are likely scenario-driven (1a is sparse with few near-collisions per rollout) rather than implementation-driven.

C11_config_lock_hash_drift_check.detail: All 8 hashes in config_lock.json match disk SHA256 verbatim: config_frozen_v1.yaml, configs/pde/{eikonal_aux,hjb_aux,soft_hjb_aux,cbf_aux}.yaml, configs/reward/default.yaml, env/sumo_env.py:lines_50_100, env/sumo_env.py:lines_1380_1430. No drift since Step 12 close.

C12_evaluate_convergence_v2_canonical_st.detail: 12/12 jobs: evaluate_convergence_v2(metrics_df) returned the canonical struct without crashing. All show converged=False, t_first=None (5k is far below convergence horizon as expected). Each struct contains the criterion_version field with value 'v2_sr_primary_post_stage3'. t_first=None handled correctly (not crash on missing data).

C13_full_tier1_dry_run_count.detail: `run_full_ablation.py --tier 1 --dry_run` produces 1,680 jobs raw → 1,440 after default filter (rule_based excluded by default). With `--include_rule_based`: 1,680 raw, no further filtering. PromptA stated 'Restore the run_full_ablation.py manifest to the full Tier 1 setup (12 combos × 6 methods × 10 seeds × 2 intents = 1,680 jobs)' — but 12×6×10×2 = 1,440, not 1,680. The 1,680 figure in PromptA assumes 7 methods (including rule_based); the 6-method count gives 1,440. NO MANIFEST WAS MODIFIED in this verification (CLI filters used instead), so 'restoration' was a no-op.
C13_full_tier1_dry_run_count.promptA_arithmetic_inconsistency: 12*6*10*2 = 1440 (not 1680 as stated). Either '6 methods' or '1,680' is a typo. Neither reading is blocking; the user should clarify whether Tier 1 is intended to include rule_based (1,680) or be PDE-trainable-only (1,440).

blockers: C5: criterion_version not auto-written to meta.json (would require code change to run_metadata.py OR a post-run annotation step)
C6: tier_label/tier not auto-written to meta.json (would require similar code change)
C7: CRITICAL — intent-ON eval fails because run_full_ablation.py:_build_eval_cmd does not propagate --use_intent flag (one-line bug; affects 50% of Tier 1)

C8: Fusion-fix new diagnostic columns (distill_loss_optimality_component / distill_loss_safety_component) not propagated to metrics.csv (affects only fusion_aux; partially mitigated by L_residual_safety being non-zero per C10)

non_blocking_observations.repo_not_git_repo: EECE_499-main is not a git repository. _git_info() in run_metadata.py falls back to placeholder values: git_commit='00000000', git_branch='unknown', git_dirty=true. All 12 meta.json files have these placeholder values. Not blocking but reproducibility/provenance is weakened — every run looks identical from a git perspective. Recommend: git init + commit at the v2_phase_3F_step_12 lock point so future runs record real provenance.
non_blocking_observations.promptA_arithmetic: PromptA states 12×6×10×2=1,680. This is internally inconsistent (=1,440). User should clarify intended interpretation before launch.
non_blocking_observations.fusion_L_residual_safety_sparseness: 1a × 5k smoke shows L_residual_safety nonzero in 1/2 iters per fusion job. Prior 50k smoke verification on 2_dense had 0.427 (denser scenario, longer horizon). This is consistent with 1a being a sparse/easy cell where CBF residuals near zero are expected when no near-collisions occur. Not a fix bug.

code_changes_made: none — verification only, per PromptA §7 'do not auto-fix, document the issue and let me decide'
scratch_outputs_under_tmp: /tmp/pre_tier1_micro/tier1/<12 job dirs>/{metrics.csv, meta.json, eval_metrics.csv (partial or header-only), stdout.log}
tier_1_recommendation: DO NOT LAUNCH Tier 1 until at minimum the C7 (intent eval) bug is fixed. C5/C6 (meta fields) and C8 (Fusion CSV columns) are softer blockers — depending on user preference, they could be addressed via either code changes or analysis-pipeline-side workarounds. PromptA's arithmetic ambiguity (C13) should also be reconciled before commit.
